source_caption:
Hollywood has spent nearly $600 million trying to bring Matt Damon home.

It started with Saving Private Ryan ($70M), where an entire squad was sent to bring Private Ryan home. Then came Interstellar ($165M), where humanity crossed galaxies only to find him stranded on an alien planet. In The Martian ($108M), NASA mounted a rescue mission to bring Mark Watney back from Mars. And now, in Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey ($250M), Damon is once again on an epic journey home as Odysseus.

At this point, getting Matt Damon home is a cinematic tradition.
